sources.description:
Chen Yufan in Grey Suit

Chen Yufan poses in a sleek, double-breasted grey suit paired with a crisp white shirt, his dark hair styled to one side. The portrait captures his composed expression and modern fashion sense, highlighting the clean lines and tailored fit of his attire.
